prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive or near-zero outcomes after noise correction.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -2.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +11.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Persistence Warning Hint: Display a helpful warning hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to recover existing pet data. (why: Support received 8 tickets about pets being missing or reset after users signed in with a different account method.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a clear split layout highlighting pre-made vs custom pet options side by side. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis and confusion between options.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Photo Preview Screen: Add a dedicated photo review screen after photo upload so users can check photo quality before starting pet creation. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% drop-off rate and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining basic desktop pet shortcuts while files compile. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
4: [finish, layout] Home Intro Card Layout Overhaul: Change the home intro screen layout to card style featuring clear visual instructions on desktop pet placement and controls. (why: Finish stage completion is 64.8% and multiple support emails cite confusion regarding controlling or hiding pets post-setup.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint: Add clear image specification hints directly on the photo upload screen explaining proper photo angles and lighting. (why: Support received 3 complaints regarding custom pet generation failing or rendering with incorrect visual attributes.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Checklist Finish Flow: Reframe the final onboarding step into a brief interactive checklist layout introducing core desktop pet interactions. (why: Post-onboarding support issues show users are confused about how to manage, hide, or talk to pets right after onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Action Copy Clarification: Update headline and button wording on the path selection screen to set clear expectations for the next step. (why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path indicates users hesitate due to ambiguous outcome descriptions.)
8: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Generation Status Badge: Add an explicit progress badge and readiness notification switch to the waiting screen to inform users during model building. (why: Waiting step drop-off and high mean time (2336s) signal users think the app has frozen during generation.)
